album/{albumId}.note: Legacy view model reads mediaType/mediaId, which this route does not supply. Caller passes album.name, not an id

audio_player/{path}.note: No call sites; path argument unused. Candidate for plain deletion

music_player.note: Already redirects to the live player

opds_catalog.note: Live route hosts the OPDS browser

podcast_detail/{podcastId}.note: Legacy view model reads mediaType/mediaId, which this route does not supply

reader/{mediaId}.note: Legacy view model defaults mediaType to book

reading_statistics.note: Placeholder screen with no call sites

storage_browser.note: Legacy imports the picked file and opens document-reader; confirm the live browser does the same

video_player/{videoId}.note: Same screen and view model as the live route

webfiction_story/{storyId}.note: Legacy view model reads mediaId, which this route does not supply
